answer: Standing forms inside geodes: every claim is a hollow rock outside, its value a crystal lining only a strike reveals. Each epoch of verified work deposits one onyx band inside, stamped with its epoch, and the random roll cracks a sample open - the lining must read as the ledger says it grew, band for band. A rock whose rings were painted after the fact fails crystallography, since formation order cannot be faked after cooling, and a failed assay voids the lining. Bands nectar-thin - epochs without work - read as gaps, and gaps compound. Honest accounts grow one true epoch at a time.
